entries.speaker: Cynical Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: What's up with that smug self-satisfied[n]look on your faces? I don't like it...

entries.speaker: Cynical Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: The only reason you can act so grand is[n]that you live in a safe zone, devoid of[n]possible failure.

entries.speaker: Cynical Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: How does it feel to hear the truth?[n]Are you relieved to know you've been[n]fooling yourselves?

entries.speaker: Cynical Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Now what I really can't understand is[n]what you call "happiness."

entries.speaker: Cynical Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: But whatever, I guess. Everyone has their[n]own way to reach it.

entries.speaker: Cynical Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Either way, stop trying to tell us what[n]to do. This is how we can attain true[n]happiness.

entries.speaker: Cynical Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: I don't care what you guys think of it.[n]We have no reason to listen to your[n]complaints!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... If you truly believe all of that,[n]then you are free to do as you wish.

entries.speaker: Unfriendly Woman
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves? I don't care if they[n]exist or not.

entries.speaker: Unfriendly Woman
entries.en: It was a fun joke while it lasted, but it's old[n]news now. Tell me something a little more[n]exciting.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A joke!? Bullshit!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know people have actually died from[n]those mental shutdowns, right!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You ever thought of that!?

entries.speaker: Vacant Young Man
entries.en: Politics? Would taking an interest in[n]that really matter now? Nothing would[n]change...

entries.speaker: Vacant Young Man
entries.en: I'd rather use that time for myself before[n]it's too late...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's no such thing as "time for yourself"[n]in a prison cell. Why are they acting like[n]this...?

entries.speaker: Cynical Woman
entries.en: Don't do anything unnecessary. This is[n]going to be a beautiful end to our world...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How can one who cannot open their eyes[n]be a judge of beauty...?

entries.speaker: Resigned Young Man
entries.en: Reality is ending, right? There's no point[n]working hard now.

entries.speaker: Resigned Young Man
entries.en: And my dreams...? I just have to deal with[n]never seeing them come true. It's a cruel[n]fact of life.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: "Reality is ending"?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is similar to what the others in the[n]prison are saying... What could that mean?
